{{Top|leg}}
'''Public Works''' was a department of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] government. Over a [[Standard century/Legends|century]] prior to the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Public Works purchased ten thousand [[IC-M General Utility Droid|RC-M General Utility Droids]] to perform simple maintenance and repair duties on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Each droid was dispatched after Public Works painted their logo on the chassis, and affixed a combination [[Restraining bolt/Legends|restraining bolt]]/[[locational transponder]].<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
